name: Squeezy Fish
tagline: Hold to puff. Release to dive.
description: Guide a pufferfish through an endless reef. Inflate for a bigger score, then deflate to squeeze through the coral and escape the shark.
features: One-touch puff-and-dive controls
Coral gaps that reward timing
Quick runs and another chance to beat your best

name: Doodle Legs
tagline: Your next great idea has legs.
description: Draw a pair of legs for NIBS and watch your scribble become a moving mechanism. Redraw mid-run to tackle an ever-changing obstacle course.
features: Draw the shape that moves your character
Experiment with loops, hooks and strides
Adapt your drawing as the obstacles change

name: Wax & Wane
tagline: A private journal that keeps time with the moon.
description: Light three candles, write a page and seal it in wax. Each night is read against the real sky, so over a cycle you see how you move with the moon.
features: A nightly rite: candles, a page and a wax seal
Readings calculated on-device from the real sky and your chart
Moods by moon phase, new-moon letters and a Year Ahead

name: STOPBRAINROT
tagline: Your brain is a pet. Stop scrolling and it heals.
description: Take the 60-second Rot Check, then grow your brain back: lock-ins, urge surfing, a grove that grows while you're offline, and real-life side quests.
features: 60-second Rot Check with shareable results
Lock-ins that pay out when your phone is down
Research-backed tools like urge surfing and check-ins

name: GNASH!
description: A 90-second duel for two people and one phone. Lay it flat, take an end each, and swat the pearl into the other guardian's jaws. No ads, ever.
features: Two players, one phone, face to face
Six solo rivals and a daily challenge
No ads, no account, works offline

name: Mochi Pup
tagline: Your real dog, as a game.
description: Snap a photo and your dog becomes a squishy Mochi twin. Real training lessons, walks, meals and cuddles make it thrive.
features: Picture-led, force-free training lessons
A Trick Path of 36 tricks and life skills
Care and safety tools, free forever

name: Songlens
tagline: Hear it. See it. Play it.
description: Play any song out loud and see its chords and notes on guitar, piano, drums or bass, transcribed entirely on your phone.
features: Listens through the mic, analyses on-device
Fretboard, keys, drum lanes and bass neck
Slow down, loop and play along
